create_vibevoice_asr_model: create a VibeVoice ASR model for speech recognition from a pre-trained config
run_vibevoice_asr_generation: run VibeVoice ASR generation to transcribe audio into text using the model forward pass
encode_audio_features: encode audio input into embeddings using VibeVoiceAsrForConditionalGeneration.get_audio_features
prepare_generation_inputs: prepare inputs for autoregressive text generation with VibeVoiceAsrForConditionalGeneration.prepare_inputs_for_generation
build_multi_modal_projector: build a VibeVoiceAsrMultiModalProjector to combine acoustic and semantic latents into shared embeddings
